invariants: User-visible event is emitted before the worker runs.
At most one worker runs per thread; inbox provides queueing.
Streaming deltas are live-only; only the final assistant message is persisted.
Final assistant event reuses the stream id.
Slow subscribers are dropped instead of growing an unbounded queue.
Restart repairs pending, running, live, and hold states before the thread is reused.

failureHandling.behavior: ValueError to HTTP 400; no timeline event
clear inbox, expire pending approvals/questions, cancel worker, settle tool boundary
notice event, finally clears busy and restores idle
EventBus removes subscriber; reconnect and history reload required
client marks auth error and stops retry
repair stale running/live/pending/hold states from timeline

risks: WebSocket onopen resets retry attempt, allowing fast retry loops for open-then-close failures.
Deltas have no sequence numbers in the upstream protocol, so exact suffix replay is impossible.
Timeline fan-out is process-local and lacks shared pub/sub or cross-instance sequence allocation.
Unpersisted partial text is lost if the process stops before the final assistant event.
Before cursor outside the 2000-event retention window degrades to a tail page and may produce duplicates.
The five-file REA fixture does not cover the Python server modules; those findings come from direct source reading.

auth.http: Authorization: Bearer token; legacy ?token is rejected with 401
auth.websocket: first-frame auth within 10 seconds; failure closes 4401
auth.signedFiles: HMAC-SHA256 over exp newline path, 128-bit truncated signature, expiry bounded to about 13 hours

eventAdapter.runLifecycle: begin_run resets per-run stream, artifact, browser and model state; end_run closes live browser cards
eventAdapter.toolUpdates: tool call creates running chip; tool result patches ok/error/blocked with output preview capped at 600 characters
eventAdapter.artifacts: workspace mtime diff before and after non-read-only tools; same path reuses the same card
eventAdapter.browser: bounded in-memory frame set; one card per run updated by patch
eventAdapter.approvals: future registered before card emission; timeout patches expired; resolve wakes the waiting run
eventAdapter.questions: one future per thread; next matching user message resolves it without starting a model run

persistence.session: model Message history and turn count per thread
persistence.restartRepair: pending cards become expired, running tools become error, live browser/hands become done, holds become stale off, orphan tool calls receive synthetic results

risks: EventBus capacity is measured in messages, not bytes.
Timeline and session writes are separate and can diverge on a crash between them.
Inbox items are not durable and are lost on restart.
Workspace artifact detection depends on mtime resolution and external file changes.
Signed file URLs remain bearer-like capabilities until expiry.
WebSocket send commands have no idempotency key.

sendPaths: No attachments and writable WebSocket: send command over WebSocket.
Attachments or unavailable WebSocket: POST send over REST.
Cloud-once send: always REST so refusal is synchronously returned.

reducer.upsert: replace by event id; append otherwise
reducer.syncedOrdering: insert older synced events by timestamp
reducer.hello: clears transient streams and rebuilds global cards/state
reducer.streamStart: creates or replaces the thread stream
reducer.delta: append only for the matching stream id
reducer.streamEnd: mark ended; discard empty or explicitly discarded streams
reducer.assistantEvent: clear stream when the final event id matches

reconnect.defect: attempt resets in onopen before any valid data is received
